$comment: Operative source of truth for FR-5 and FR-6 (D3). The statutory text appears in exactly one place — here. It is not duplicated in code, in prompts, or in prose. Correcting this file corrects the system. Design rationale in docs/config/warning-statement.md.
appliesTo: All alcoholic beverages — beer, wine, distilled spirits
verificationNote: Confirmed byte for byte against the eCFR versioner API — raw XML, tags stripped, whitespace collapsed, compared programmatically with no model interpreting the text. Title 27 as issued 2026-07-30; 283 characters, identical. The renderer endpoint and a browser both show the same wording, but neither is the check: a legal string where one word decides a verdict is compared, not read. Re-verify by re-running the comparison in docs/deployment-runbook.md §5; the corpus cannot catch an error here because it is generated from this same file.

segments.label: Surgeon General / pregnancy
segments.text: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects.

segments.label: Impairment / health problems
segments.text: (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.

advisoryChecks.note: Required in both directions by (a)(2): capital letters AND bold type. The capitals are checked automatically; the bold is not. Stroke weight is the one item here no measurement supplies — it is perception, not metrology (D53).

advisoryChecks.text: The rest of the warning is NOT in bold type
advisoryChecks.note: Raised by no stakeholder. The regulation constrains over-emphasis as well as under-emphasis.

advisoryChecks.text: Type size meets the minimum for this container size (up to 237 mL: 1 mm; over 237 mL to 3 L: 2 mm; over 3 L: 3 mm)
advisoryChecks.note: Measurable in principle — net contents is application-record data, and the form's coordinate space gives the scale — but any measurement must be corrected by the reduction percentage declared in item 19, or it under-measures every label shrunk to fit the affix box (D53).

advisoryChecks.text: The warning is separate and apart from other label information
advisoryChecks.note: Cited to 16.21, not 16.22: the separateness requirement sits in the mandatory-information section, alongside the statement itself.

advisoryChecks.text: Readily legible, on a contrasting background, characters not compressed
advisoryChecks.note: Legibility and contrast state no threshold, so no figure is offered — a computed ratio judged against an invented bar would carry more authority than the regulation grants it. Compression is different: (a)(4) sets 40, 25 and 12 characters per inch at 1, 2 and 3 mm.

advisoryChecks.text: The label cannot be removed without thorough application of water or other solvents
advisoryChecks.note: Applies only where the label is not an integral part of the container. A property of the physical article, so no image can establish it — the one item here that no pipeline could ever close (D53).
